messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: AUTOMATED ALERT: spike in HTTP errors observed from inference-gateway (us-west1). Error rate 6.8% 1m, threshold 1%. Primary signatures: 502, 503. PagerDuty INC#123456 created and notified oncall.
jen (oncall): acked INC123456 :white_check_mark: I'm on it. grabbing current dashboard.
miguel (sre): thanks — I'm skimming logs, can you confirm if this is across all routes or a subset?
jen (oncall): appears concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/chat, traffic from api-redwood-prod-usw1. latency bumped too (~450ms p50 -> 1.2s p50).
liz (eng-runtime): kv-cache eviction logs show a flurry of mempressure events ~30s before spike. possible cache thrash when a canary rolled.
miguel (sre): can you paste the last 50 lines from the runtime log?
liz (eng-runtime): ```
2026-02-17T12:34:01Z WARN kvcache eviction start, pressure=0.87
2026-02-17T12:34:02Z INFO model-shard 3 fallback to cold-kv
2026-02-17T12:34:03Z ERROR forward-client timeout (ms=1500) target=shard-3
2026-02-17T12:34:04Z ERROR attach-kv failed: econnreset
```
jen (oncall): ok that matches the timing. rolling request routing to fallback pool now (policy: prefer-dedicated-2). running the command.
jen (oncall): ```/bin/rdctl route set inference-gateway --pool fallback-2 --sticky 15s```
miguel (sre): nice. I'm patching a quick circuit-breaker change to reduce concurrent upstream connections to the affected shard. patching via edge-config.
miguel (sre): ```
edge-config apply --service inference-gateway --set upstream.max_conns=60
```
product-ops: tagging PROD-CRIT for customer comms. do we have an estimate of affected users / SLA risk?
jen (oncall): early numbers: error budget bump ~0.9% of total qps during spike window, but certain routes for premium customers saw 2.5-3% errors. CC: @product-ops will follow up.
alerts-bot: monitoring rule: error_rate(/v1/generate) returned to 1.2% (down from 6.8%) — continuing to watch for 10m before closure.
miguel (sre): after routing and CB tweak, 5xxs dropped quickly. looks like shard 3 had transient network flaps to kv-store. opening a follow-up infra ticket for persistent networking flakiness.
liz (eng-runtime): adding a short-term mitigation note to rollout: avoid shard 3 for next canary and add a KV warmup step.
jen (oncall): good. I'm leaving a temporary route override for 30m and will hand off to miguel for the next shift.
jen (oncall): handoff: miguel takes oncall as incident owner. miguel pls escalate to infra if errors return. :v:
miguel (sre): taking it. I'll keep the PD incident open and mark customer impact as "partial errors, some premium requests affected". scheduling follow-up post-mortem.
product-ops: request to check for ~5 customers flagged as high-impact — can we surface request ids to review?
jen (oncall): added relevant request_ids to the PD incident and to the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-error (runbook snippet included).
jen (oncall): closing active mitigation loop — routing override remains until 2026-02-17T13:05Z. monitoring for 20m then will clear.
miguel (sre): PR to infra ticket: NET-987 — investigating pod network flaps and host NIC logs. will post updates.
incident-bot: Incident INC123456 status: acknowledged -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled by miguel.
product-ops: noted. will prepare customer outreach draft if infra confirms persistent regression. :speech_left:"
